//: SayIntentions ATC requests. Each is spoken on COM1 via sayAs (SayIntentions voices it). Placeholders: {callsign} {gate} {runway} {airport} {origin} from flight.json, {diversion} = the diversion destination while one is declared (issue #184). commType matches the getWX comms 'type' for auto-tune. Only active when sayIntentions.enabled = true. Add more requests freely.

requests.icao: Ground, {callsign}, stand {gate}, request push and start
requests.faa: Ground, {callsign}, gate {gate}, request push and start

requests.//: The holding-point call (owner 2026-10-29: more ways to say it — at EGLL the pilot's call at the holding point matched 'request taxi' instead). {runway} is the planned departure runway; without one the clause is dropped and the request reads 'Tower, {callsign}, ready for departure'.
requests.icao: Tower, {callsign}, holding point runway {runway}, ready for departure
requests.faa: Tower, {callsign}, holding short runway {runway}, ready for departure

requests.//: Step climb (issue #189): {stepLevel} is the planned level at the next navlog step as the FO's step-climb advisor last saw it; with no step ahead only the level clause is dropped and the request reads '{callsign}, request climb' (2026-10-25 flight: the single-clause template lost the request too and sent the bare callsign).
